fields.inspectionLicense: Number and date of the inspection licence

controller.title: 1. Data controller
controller.text: The controller of personal data within the meaning of the Serbian Law on Personal Data Protection is:

data.title: 2. What data we process
data.visit: Visiting the website. When you visit the website, the server automatically records technical data: IP address, date and time of access, browser and operating system.
data.form: Contact form. When you send us a message, we process the data you entered: full name, phone number, topic, message text and, if provided, your email address.
data.direct: Contact by phone or email. If you contact us directly, we process the data you share with us.

purpose.title: 3. Purpose and legal basis of processing
purpose.technical: Technical data is used for the secure and stable operation of the website. The legal basis is our legitimate interest.
purpose.inquiries: Data from the form and from direct contact is used to reply to your inquiry. The legal basis is taking steps at your request prior to entering into a contract, or our legitimate interest in replying to inquiries.

recipients.title: 4. Recipients and transfers abroad
recipients.intro: We do not sell your data. We use the following service providers:
recipients.hosting: Website hosting: , processes technical data about visits.
recipients.resend: Resend (USA): delivers messages from the contact form to us by email.
recipients.abroad: These providers may process data outside the Republic of Serbia, including in the USA.

map.title: 5. Map and Google Maps
map.text: The map on the website is an image hosted on our server, based on data from the OpenStreetMap project, and no data is sent to third parties when it is displayed. Google Maps only opens in a new window when you click on the map, and Google's privacy policy applies to that processing.

cookies.title: 6. Cookies
cookies.text: This website does not use tracking cookies and does not use analytics or advertising tools.

retention.title: 7. Retention period
retention.text: We keep data from inquiries for <period></period>, unless the law requires longer retention.

rights.title: 8. Your rights
rights.intro: With regard to your data, you have the right to:
rights.access: access your data and receive a copy,
rights.text: You can send your request to {email}. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Serbian Commissioner for Information of Public Importance and Personal Data Protection: <link>www.poverenik.rs</link>.

changes.title: 9. Changes
changes.text: We may update this policy from time to time. The current version is always published on this website.

register.title: Register
register.text: The company details are recorded in the register of the Serbian Business Registers Agency (APR): <link>www.apr.gov.rs</link>.

imprint.licenseText: We carry out vehicle technical inspections under an authorisation issued by the Ministry of the Interior of the Republic of Serbia.

copyright.title: Copyright
copyright.text: The content of this website, including texts, photos and illustrations, is protected by copyright. Use without permission is not allowed.
